summary: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. filed a prospectus supplement on Form 6-K to increase the maximum aggregate offering amount under an existing at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co. LLC, originally dated February 3, 2025. The supplement relates to the issuance of American Depositary Shares (each representing 10,000 ordinary shares) for aggregate proceeds of up to $2,128,000. This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not a special-situation event. No board recommendation, premium, or structural complexity is present. The filing simply updates a continuous offering program, so no risk-arb angle applies.
